tools.name: docketwise_list_contacts
tools.description: The firm's contacts (clients, leads and institutions), 200 per page: id, name, company, email, lead flag, physical address. Filter by type. Use docketwise_get_contact for one contact with its notes.

tools.name: docketwise_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with its address and notes.

tools.name: docketwise_list_matters
tools.description: The firm's matters (cases), 200 per page: id, number, title, client_id, attorney, status, type, receipt number, priority date. Use docketwise_get_matter for one matter with its client, receipts and notes.

tools.name: docketwise_get_matter
tools.description: One matter by id, with its client, receipts, notes and assigned user ids.

tools.name: docketwise_list_matter_receipts
tools.description: The USCIS receipts of one matter: receipt number, description, contact, status update type and time.

tools.name: docketwise_list_matter_types
tools.description: The firm's matter types, each with its matter statuses (workflow steps).

tools.name: docketwise_list_matter_statuses
tools.description: The firm's matter statuses (workflow steps): name, duration, sort order.

tools.name: docketwise_list_invoices
tools.description: The firm's invoices, 200 per page: number, contact, status (paid/unpaid), type (bill, trust request, disbursement), dates, total and balance.

tools.name: docketwise_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id, with the matters it covers.

tools.name: docketwise_list_invoice_charges
tools.description: The charges (services, expenses, fees) on one invoice: amount, status, date, description, matter.

tools.name: docketwise_list_documents
tools.description: The firm's documents (metadata only, no file content), 200 per page: title, client, size, uploader, archived flag. Search by title.

tools.name: docketwise_get_document
tools.description: One document's metadata by id (title, client, size, uploader, link to the document in Docketwise). No file content.

tools.name: docketwise_get_document_download_url
tools.description: A temporary (one hour) download URL for one document's file. Anyone holding the link can download the file while it is valid: share it only with the user who asked.

tools.name: docketwise_list_users
tools.description: The firm's Docketwise users (attorneys and staff): id, email, name. Use the ids as user_ids when creating a matter.

tools.name: docketwise_list_countries
tools.description: Docketwise's country list: id, name, ISO code, phone code. Reference data.

tools.name: docketwise_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new contact (person or institution) in the firm's Docketwise. Optionally with one address and one daytime phone. Creates a record; it does not check for duplicates.

tools.name: docketwise_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: changes the basic fields of one contact (name, company, email, lead flag). Only the fields you give are sent; each replaces the stored value. Addresses and phones are not changed here.

tools.name: docketwise_create_matter
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new matter (case) for an existing client contact in the firm's Docketwise. The client_id is required; user_ids are the firm users assigned (docketwise_list_users).

tools.name: docketwise_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: adds a note to a matter or to a client contact (give matter_id or client_id) in the firm's Docketwise.

tools.name: docketwise_update_note
tools.description: WRITE: replaces the title and/or text of an existing note. The previous text is not kept by this server. Docketwise requires matter_id or client_id again (the matter or client the note belongs to).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: docketwise_list_contacts, docketwise_get_document_download_url, docketwise_list_users · Private data: docketwise_list_contacts, docketwise_get_contact, docketwise_list_matter_receipts, docketwise_list_invoices, docketwise_list_documents, docketwise_get_document, docketwise_get_document_download_url, docketwise_create_contact, docketwise_update_contact, docketwise_create_matter, docketwise_create_note · Public sink: docketwise_list_contacts, docketwise_get_document_download_url, docketwise_list_users, docketwise_update_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: docketwise_list_contacts, docketwise_get_document_download_url, docketwise_list_users · Private data: docketwise_list_contacts, docketwise_get_contact, docketwise_list_matter_receipts, docketwise_list_invoices, docketwise_list_documents, docketwise_get_document, docketwise_get_document_download_url, docketwise_create_contact, docketwise_update_contact, docketwise_create_matter, docketwise_create_note · Public sink: docketwise_list_contacts, docketwise_get_document_download_url, docketwise_list_users, docketwise_update_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
